The '''mission''' to [[Rentalles/Legends|Rentalles]] was launched by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to recover a [[Hyperwave signal interceptor]].

The [[Ministry of Supply]] was able to re-locate an abandoned [[Rentalles Rebel listening post|listening post]], so a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of troopers was sent to locate the HSI.

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] objective was to ensure that the [[Rentalles Imperial garrison]] was completely cleared.

{{Mission-stub}}
